Alex —

Thanks for the context. Quick heads-up: we've seen multiple short extension/top-up requests that look like the same org re-signing under new accounts to consume promotional credits. Before we approve anything I need a couple items to speed the review:

1) A single point of contact for billing or PO (name + email)
2) Confirmation you want the credits tied to the org (PaddleWorks) and not to the individual accounts listed in the CSV
3) Any internal note on why the teams opened separate signups (e.g., procurement, separate orgs)

Ben, can you pull a session-id clustering check and flag suspicious patterns? I attached an internal stub with what to look for.

We can do a one-time 7-day extension tied to an org-level verification, but we need the above by EOD Thu to meet their demo.

Best,

Internal - quick analysis:

I pulled the session ids and account metadata from the CSV Alex sent. Flags:
- 7 distinct signups with overlapping IP ranges and identical UA strings
- Two accounts used the same payment email pattern (reused alias+number)
- Ten session IDs repeated across signups (possible shared scripting or replay)

Recommend the following next steps before adding org-level credits:
- Pause any additional promo top-ups for these accounts (prevent immediate consumption)
- Require org verification: corporate email domain confirmation or PO from Priya Das
- Ask for a short attestation describing why split signups were used and whether the teams will consolidate

If they provide PO / consolidated billing, we can approve a one-time org credit and retroapply a proportional amount. Flagging as moderately high risk for promo replay.

Ben Carter

Alex —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the PO contact. After an internal review we will: 

- Put a temporary hold on additional promo/top-up credits for the individual accounts you listed. This is to prevent immediate replay while we verify org-level claims.
- If PaddleWorks provides a PO from Priya Das or confirmation of consolidated billing by EOD Mon (2026-12-07), we will approve a one-time org-level 7-day extension and a proportional credit equal to the consumed promo amount across the accounts.
- Please include in your reply: the billing PO number or an email from Priya that confirms consolidation, and a one-paragraph attestation about the separate signups. That will expedite the approval.

Monica will coordinate the credit allocation and make sure we don't double-credit if any accounts are closed/merged. Ben flagged repeated session IDs that look like replay; if you can confirm these were legitimate shared tests (and not automated promo replay), that helps our assessment.

If we don't receive PO/attestation by the deadline, we'll close the approval request and recommend you apply for a standard paid pilot.

Thanks,
